1: #Requires -Version 7.0
2: <#
3: .SYNOPSIS
4:     Sends the text of a local PowerShell script to PAYTON-LEGION2 through the operator's WSMan
5:     wrapper and prints the output. The script file is analyzed locally before it is sent.
6: .PARAMETER ScriptPath
7:     Local .ps1 file whose content runs remotely (as lab-wsman).
8: .PARAMETER OutFile
9:     Optional local file that also receives the output.
10: #>
11: [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess)]
12: param(
13:     [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ScriptPath,
14:     [string]$OutFile
15: )
16: Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
17: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
18: 
19: $wrapper = Join-Path $HOME '.creds/Invoke-LegionWsman.ps1'
20: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $wrapper)) { throw "WSMan wrapper not found at $wrapper" }
21: $resolved = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $ScriptPath).Path
22: 
23: $tokens = $null
24: $parseErrors = $null
25: [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($resolved, [ref]$tokens, [ref]$parseErrors) | Out-Null
26: if ($parseErrors.Count -gt 0) { throw "Remote script has $($parseErrors.Count) parse errors; not sent." }
27: 
28: $remote = Get-Content -LiteralPath $resolved -Raw
29: if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('PAYTON-LEGION2', "Run $resolved")) {
30:     'WHATIF remote script follows:'
31:     $remote
32:     return
33: }
34: 
35: "LOCAL START $((Get-Date).ToString('s')) script=$resolved"
36: # The wrapper's output reaches the console outside the PowerShell pipeline, so Tee-Object on an
37: # in-process call captured nothing. A child pwsh gets a real stdout pipe that its descendants inherit.
38: $lines = & pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File $wrapper -Command $remote 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }
39: $lines
40: if ($OutFile) {
41:     $header = "RECEIPT $((Get-Date).ToString('s')) host=PAYTON-LEGION2 script=$resolved"
42:     Set-Content -LiteralPath $OutFile -Value (@($header) + @($lines)) -Encoding utf8
43:     "LOCAL SAVED $OutFile lines=$(@($lines).Count) bytes=$((Get-Item -LiteralPath $OutFile).Length)"
44: }
45: "LOCAL END $((Get-Date).ToString('s'))"

1: #Requires -Version 7.0
2: # Read-only remote probe (runs on PAYTON-LEGION2 as lab-wsman): reports whether the interactive lane
3: # worktree and its TestResults exist, its HEAD, and a TRX summary (counts and every non-passed case).
4: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
5: $env:GIT_CONFIG_COUNT = '1'
6: $env:GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0 = 'safe.directory'
7: $env:GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0 = '*'
8: $wt = 'F:/GitHub/McpServer/.worktrees/unit-green-interactive-20261019'
9: $runRoot = Join-Path $wt 'TestResults/unit-green-win-interactive-20261019'
10: "PROBE $((Get-Date).ToString('s')) host=$env:COMPUTERNAME user=$env:USERNAME"
11: "WORKTREE exists=$(Test-Path -LiteralPath $wt)"
12: if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $wt) {
13:     try { "HEAD $((git -C $wt rev-parse HEAD 2>&1) -join ' ')" } catch { "HEAD unreadable: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
14:     $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $wt
15:     "WORKTREE created=$($item.CreationTime.ToString('s')) owner=$((Get-Acl -LiteralPath $wt).Owner)"
16: }
17: "TESTRESULTS exists=$(Test-Path -LiteralPath $runRoot)"
18: if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runRoot) {

23:             $nsm = [System.Xml.XmlNamespaceManager]::new($doc.NameTable)
24:             $nsm.AddNamespace('t', $doc.DocumentElement.NamespaceURI)
25:             $c = $doc.SelectSingleNode('//t:ResultSummary/t:Counters', $nsm)

27:             "TRX $($trx.FullName.Substring($runRoot.Length)) written=$($trx.LastWriteTime.ToString('s')) start=$($times.GetAttribute('start')) total=$($c.GetAttribute('total')) executed=$($c.GetAttribute('executed')) passed=$($c.GetAttribute('passed')) failed=$($c.GetAttribute('failed')) notExecuted=$($c.GetAttribute('notExecuted'))"
28:             foreach ($r in $doc.SelectNodes('//t:UnitTestResult[@outcome!="Passed"]', $nsm)) {

30:                 $msg = if ($null -ne $m) { ($m.InnerText -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim() } else { '' }
31:                 if ($msg.Length -gt 400) { $msg = $msg.Substring(0, 400) }
32:                 "  $($r.GetAttribute('outcome')) $($r.GetAttribute('testName')) :: $msg"
33:             }
34:         }
35:         catch { "TRX $($trx.FullName) unreadable: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
36:     }
37: }
38: "END $((Get-Date).ToString('s'))"
